https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated environments for software testing, enabling developers and QA teams to instantly create and manage test environments to streamline application development and deployment processes.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create automated test environments through a simple interface.
Users must be able to integrate with third-party CI/CD tools for seamless deployment workflows.
Users must be able to monitor the status and performance of active test environments in real-time.
Users must be able to duplicate or replicate existing test environments for additional testing scenarios.
Users must be able to manage access permissions to test environments based on roles, ensuring secure collaboration.
Users must be able to schedule the creation and teardown of test environments to optimize resource utilization.
Users must be able to view usage analytics and reports to evaluate testing efficiency and resource consumption.
